paragraphs.text: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but prove the spirits, whether they are of God; because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
paragraphs.original: Ἀγαπητοί, μὴ παντὶ πνεύματι πιστεύετε, ἀλλὰ δοκιμάζετε τὰ πνεύματα εἰ ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν, ὅτι πολλοὶ ψευδοπροφῆται ἐξεληλύθασιν εἰς τὸν κόσμον.
paragraphs.translit: Agapētoi, mē panti pneumati pisteuete, alla dokimazete ta pneumata ei ek tou theou estin, hoti polloi pseudoprophētai exelēlythasin eis ton kosmon.

paragraphs.text: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:
paragraphs.original: ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκετε τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ θεοῦ· πᾶν πνεῦμα ὃ ὁμολογεῖ Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐν σαρκὶ ἐληλυθότα ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν,
paragraphs.translit: en toutō ginōskete to pneuma tou theou· pan pneuma ho homologei Iēsoun Christon en sarki elēlythota ek tou theou estin,

paragraphs.text: and every spirit that confesseth not Jesus is not of God: and this is the [spirit] of the antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it cometh; and now it is in the world already.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πᾶν πνεῦμα ὃ μὴ ὁμολογεῖ τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ἔστιν· καὶ τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ τοῦ ἀντιχρίστου, ὃ ἀκηκόατε ὅτι ἔρχεται, καὶ νῦν ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἐστὶν ἤδη.
paragraphs.translit: kai pan pneuma ho mē homologei ton Iēsoun ek tou theou ouk estin· kai touto estin to tou antichristou, ho akēkoate hoti erchetai, kai nyn en tō kosmō estin ēdē.

paragraphs.text: Ye are of God, [my] little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world.
paragraphs.original: ὑμεῖς ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστε, τεκνία, καὶ νενικήκατε αὐτούς, ὅτι μείζων ἐστὶν ὁ ἐν ὑμῖν ἢ ὁ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ·
paragraphs.translit: hymeis ek tou theou este, teknia, kai nenikēkate autous, hoti meizōn estin ho en hymin ē ho en tō kosmō·

paragraphs.text: They are of the world: therefore speak they [as] of the world, and the world heareth them.
paragraphs.original: αὐτοὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου εἰσίν· διὰ τοῦτο ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου λαλοῦσιν καὶ ὁ κόσμος αὐτῶν ἀκούει.
paragraphs.translit: autoi ek tou kosmou eisin· dia touto ek tou kosmou lalousin kai ho kosmos autōn akouei.

paragraphs.text: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he who is not of God heareth us not. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
paragraphs.original: ἡμεῖς ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐσμεν· ὁ γινώσκων τὸν θεὸν ἀκούει ἡμῶν, ὃς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ἀκούει ἡμῶν. ἐκ τούτου γινώσκομεν τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς πλάνης.
paragraphs.translit: hēmeis ek tou theou esmen· ho ginōskōn ton theon akouei hēmōn, hos ouk estin ek tou theou ouk akouei hēmōn. ek toutou ginōskomen to pneuma tēs alētheias kai to pneuma tēs planēs.

paragraphs.text: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is begotten of God, and knoweth God.
paragraphs.original: Ἀγαπητοί, ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους, ὅτι ἡ ἀγάπη ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν, καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἀγαπῶν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ γεγέννηται καὶ γινώσκει τὸν θεόν.
paragraphs.translit: Agapētoi, agapōmen allēlous, hoti hē agapē ek tou theou estin, kai pas ho agapōn ek tou theou gegennētai kai ginōskei ton theon.

paragraphs.text: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
paragraphs.original: ὁ μὴ ἀγαπῶν οὐκ ἔγνω τὸν θεόν, ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ἀγάπη ἐστίν.
paragraphs.translit: ho mē agapōn ouk egnō ton theon, hoti ho theos agapē estin.

paragraphs.text: Herein was the love of God manifested in us, that God hath sent his only begotten Son into the world that we might live through him.
paragraphs.original: ἐν τούτῳ ἐφανερώθη ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν ἡμῖν, ὅτι τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ τὸν μονογενῆ ἀπέσταλκεν ὁ θεὸς εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἵνα ζήσωμεν διʼ αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: en toutō ephanerōthē hē agapē tou theou en hēmin, hoti ton hyion autou ton monogenē apestalken ho theos eis ton kosmon hina zēsōmen diʼ autou.

paragraphs.text: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son [to be] the propitiation for our sins.
paragraphs.original: ἐν τούτῳ ἐστὶν ἡ ἀγάπη, οὐχ ὅτι ἡμεῖς ἠγαπήκαμεν τὸν θεόν, ἀλλʼ ὅτι αὐτὸς ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἱλασμὸν περὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: en toutō estin hē agapē, ouch hoti hēmeis ēgapēkamen ton theon, allʼ hoti autos ēgapēsen hēmas kai apesteilen ton hyion autou hilasmon peri tōn hamartiōn hēmōn.

paragraphs.text: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
paragraphs.original: ἀγαπητοί, εἰ οὕτως ὁ θεὸς ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς, καὶ ἡμεῖς ὀφείλομεν ἀλλήλους ἀγαπᾶν.
paragraphs.translit: agapētoi, ei houtōs ho theos ēgapēsen hēmas, kai hēmeis opheilomen allēlous agapan.

paragraphs.text: No man hath beheld God at any time: if we love one another, God abideth in us, and his love is perfected in us:
paragraphs.original: θεὸν οὐδεὶς πώποτε τεθέαται· ἐὰν ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους, ὁ θεὸς ἐν ἡμῖν μένει καὶ ἡ ἀγάπη αὐτοῦ ἐν ἡμῖν τετελειωμένη ἐστιν.
paragraphs.translit: theon oudeis pōpote tetheatai· ean agapōmen allēlous, ho theos en hēmin menei kai hē agapē autou en hēmin teteleiōmenē estin.

paragraphs.text: hereby we know that we abide in him and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
paragraphs.original: Ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ μένομεν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν ἡμῖν, ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ πνεύματος αὐτοῦ δέδωκεν ἡμῖν.
paragraphs.translit: En toutō ginōskomen hoti en autō menomen kai autos en hēmin, hoti ek tou pneumatos autou dedōken hēmin.

paragraphs.text: And we have beheld and bear witness that the Father hath sent the Son [to be] the Saviour of the world.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἡμεῖς τεθεάμεθα καὶ μαρτυροῦμεν ὅτι ὁ πατὴρ ἀπέσταλκεν τὸν υἱὸν σωτῆρα τοῦ κόσμου.
paragraphs.translit: kai hēmeis tetheametha kai martyroumen hoti ho patēr apestalken ton hyion sōtēra tou kosmou.

paragraphs.text: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God abideth in him, and he in God.
paragraphs.original: ὃς ἐὰν ὁμολογήσῃ ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ, ὁ θεὸς ἐν αὐτῷ μένει καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν τῷ θεῷ.
paragraphs.translit: hos ean homologēsē hoti Iēsous estin ho hyios tou theou, ho theos en autō menei kai autos en tō theō.

paragraphs.text: And we know and have believed the love which God hath in us. God is love; and he that abideth in love abideth in God, and God abideth in him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐγνώκαμεν καὶ πεπιστεύκαμεν τὴν ἀγάπην ἣν ἔχει ὁ θεὸς ἐν ἡμῖν. Ὁ θεὸς ἀγάπη ἐστίν, καὶ ὁ μένων ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ ἐν τῷ θεῷ μένει καὶ ὁ θεὸς ἐν αὐτῷ μένει.
paragraphs.translit: kai hēmeis egnōkamen kai pepisteukamen tēn agapēn hēn echei ho theos en hēmin. Ho theos agapē estin, kai ho menōn en tē agapē en tō theō menei kai ho theos en autō menei.

paragraphs.text: Herein is love made perfect with us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment; because as he is, even so are we in this world.
paragraphs.original: ἐν τούτῳ τετελείωται ἡ ἀγάπη μεθʼ ἡμῶν, ἵνα παρρησίαν ἔχωμεν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς κρίσεως, ὅτι καθὼς ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐσμεν ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ τούτῳ.
paragraphs.translit: en toutō teteleiōtai hē agapē methʼ hēmōn, hina parrēsian echōmen en tē hēmera tēs kriseōs, hoti kathōs ekeinos estin kai hēmeis esmen en tō kosmō toutō.

paragraphs.text: There is no fear in love: but perfect love casteth out fear, because fear hath punishment; and he that feareth is not made perfect in love.
paragraphs.original: φόβος οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ, ἀλλʼ ἡ τελεία ἀγάπη ἔξω βάλλει τὸν φόβον, ὅτι ὁ φόβος κόλασιν ἔχει, ὁ δὲ φοβούμενος οὐ τετελείωται ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ.
paragraphs.translit: phobos ouk estin en tē agapē, allʼ hē teleia agapē exō ballei ton phobon, hoti ho phobos kolasin echei, ho de phoboumenos ou teteleiōtai en tē agapē.

paragraphs.text: We love, because he first loved us.
paragraphs.original: ἡμεῖς ἀγαπῶμεν, ὅτι αὐτὸς πρῶτος ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: hēmeis agapōmen, hoti autos prōtos ēgapēsen hēmas.

paragraphs.text: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, cannot love God whom he hath not seen.
paragraphs.original: ἐάν τις εἴπῃ ὅτι Ἀγαπῶ τὸν θεόν, καὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ μισῇ, ψεύστης ἐστίν· ὁ γὰρ μὴ ἀγαπῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ὃν ἑώρακεν, τὸν θεὸν ὃν οὐχ ἑώρακεν οὐ δύναται ἀγαπᾶν.
paragraphs.translit: ean tis eipē hoti Agapō ton theon, kai ton adelphon autou misē, pseustēs estin· ho gar mē agapōn ton adelphon autou hon heōraken, ton theon hon ouch heōraken ou dynatai agapan.

paragraphs.text: And this commandment have we from him, that he who loveth God love his brother also.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ταύτην τὴν ἐντολὴν ἔχομεν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ, ἵνα ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὸν θεὸν ἀγαπᾷ καὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: kai tautēn tēn entolēn echomen apʼ autou, hina ho agapōn ton theon agapa kai ton adelphon autou.
